app.name: JSONPrism
app.description: One JSON input. Eight target formats. Fully in your browser.

home.input_placeholder: Paste your JSON here, drop files, or load a sample…
home.output_empty: Output will appear here once you provide valid JSON.
home.drop_zone_hint: Up to 500 files. Everything runs in your browser — nothing leaves your device.

format_status.no_reverse: Reverse parse not supported for this format

jsonl.pretty_desc: Canonical JSONL is single-line. Enable for human-readable multi-line records.

csv.header_desc: Emit the first row as column names derived from object keys.
csv.nested_strategy_desc: How to handle nested objects/arrays inside cells.

xml.item_name_desc: Used for items when the root is an array. Object keys name their own array items.

toml.sort_keys_desc: Recursive — applies at every nesting level. Useful for stable diffs.

markdown.escape_pipes_desc: Replace | with \| inside cell values so they don't break the table.

sql.multi_row_desc: Combine rows into a single INSERT statement per chunk.
sql.chunk_size_desc: Maximum rows per INSERT when multi-row is on.
sql.include_create_desc: Infer column types from the first row and emit a CREATE TABLE statement.

resx.comment_key_desc: When an entry is shaped as { value, _comment }, this key supplies the <comment> element.
resx.include_schema_desc: Visual Studio expects this. Disable only if you're generating diffs.
resx.sort_keys_desc: Useful for stable diffs across locale files.

bson.encoding_desc: How to render the binary BSON output as text. Downloads always contain raw bytes.

cbor.encoding_desc: How to render the binary CBOR output as text. Downloads always contain raw bytes.

msgpack.encoding_desc: How to render the binary MessagePack output as text. Downloads always contain raw bytes.

settings.title: Options
settings.description: Adjust how this format is generated. Settings persist per format.
settings.no_options: No options for this format yet.
settings.no_options_long: This converter doesn't expose any options yet. Once Phase 2 lands, you'll find dialect, indent, and other knobs here.

batch.title: Batch queue
batch.description: Process multiple JSON files into {{format}} at once. All processing happens in your browser.
batch.empty: No files queued yet. Drop JSON files above to begin.

errors.converter_not_ready: This converter is not implemented yet.
errors.converter_not_ready_phase: This converter lands in Phase {{phase}}. See the roadmap for status.
errors.batch_limit: Batch limit reached ({{max}} files). Remove some files first.

about.title: About JSONPrism
about.p1: JSONPrism takes a single JSON input and disperses it into many target formats — like white light through a prism. Everything runs client-side, so your data never leaves your device.
about.p2: Built with React 19, Vite 6, Tailwind CSS v4, and shadcn/ui. Source on GitHub.
